title: Translocation control elements, reporter codes and other means for translocation control for nanopore sequencing
abstract: The present invention provides phosphoramidate-based monomers for synthesizing expandable polymers for nanopore-based sensing. Such monomers include a reporter construct comprising a first reporter code, a symmetrical chemical branch with a translocation control element, and a second reporter code, wherein the termini of the reporter construct are connected to phosphoramidate-nucleosides. Related methods and products are also provided.
